newsitem.title: USA: Murder suspect commits suicide at police station.
newsitem.headline: Murder suspect commits suicide at police station.

text.p: A suspect in the fatal shooting of his girlfriend killed himself in front of police headquarters on Monday, authorities said.
New Haven police said Robert Williams, 58, shot himself in the head after getting out of his car at the police station, where he had arranged to turn himself in.
Williams was a suspect in the murder Sunday of his girlfriend, Linda Gagum, 31. Police said he had argued with her on Sunday and was seen leaving her apartment after the shooting.
No other details were immediately available.
